clips.title: The story
paras: Raven Hill is a desolate, ruined village in western Duskwood sitting in the long shadow of the vast Raven Hill Cemetery. Once a lively human settlement, it lies abandoned by all but a handful of frightened squatters and invisible spirits.

Situated along the western thoroughfare of Duskwood just north of Addle's Stead, Raven Hill is a tragic shell of its former self. When dark magic and undead horrors swept through the Grand Hamlet region, the living evacuated eastward toward Darkshire or fled the territory entirely. Today, ruined timber homes rot beneath perpetual gloom, avoided by travelers who fear both the restless dead wandering down from the neighboring cemetery and the invisible Unseen lurking between the crumbling walls.

Despite its bleak reputation, Raven Hill is not entirely uninhabited. A nervous wreck of an adventurer named Jitters hides among the abandoned structures, terrified of the horrors that stalk the woods. Higher up in one of the dilapidated attics, an entrepreneurial goblin named Bliztik ekes out a solitary living selling supplies to wary passersby. They share the ruins with invisible spirits known as the Unseen, living on borrowed time at the edge of the sprawling burial grounds.
